faq_heading: Hawthorne condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Hawthorne sell for?
faq.a: 10 condos sold in Hawthorne between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $606,250.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Hawthorne?
faq.a: The median was 40 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Hawthorne sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 10 condos that sold in Hawthorne went for between $560,000 and $645,250, around a median of $606,250.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Hawthorne sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 10 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Hawthorne?
faq.a: Of the 10 sales, 10 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $461.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Hawthorne?
faq.a: The median year built was 1992 for the 10 condos sold in Hawthorne.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Hawthorne usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Hawthorne had 2 bedrooms, from the 10 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Hawthorne condos and townhomes for sale now
What Hawthorne condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

10 condos sold in Hawthorne with a median price of $606,250 (the middle half sold between $560,000 and $645,250), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $577 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $461 a month. 8 townhomes sold in Hawthorne with a median price of $702,500 (the middle half sold between $635,750 and $800,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $544 per square foot, a median year built of 1976 and a median strata fee of $400 a month.

blocks.text: How Hawthorne compares with the rest of Ladner

The median condo in Hawthorne sold for $606,250, about the same as the Ladner median of $600,000 across 49 sales. Hawthorne condos took a median 40 days to sell, against 35 days for Ladner as a whole.
